Looked like a fun little game but its honestly just stressful and annoying. The table just gets full way too fast and just when you think everything is neat you get a massive suitcase to try and fit in. You will not have enough time to do this and people will show up looking for stuff while you're trying or a robber will start taking your earnings. The upgrade items available also take up space on the table which in some cases made me wonder if I would be better throwing them in the bin for table space. Money you earn will appear on the table, usually this will be behind items so you have to go through and try to click behind them, you can usually do this at the end of the day but if you're low on money you might go into a negative and end your run because you didn't. Not sure why it isn't just automatic. The game will often lag when a lot of items get bumped and screen freezes for a couple of seconds. There's also a magnifying glass item in the game which is supposed to tell you how much items are but the tool tip for the item doesn't disappear when you pick it up so half of the time you can't see the values. Really feels a bit unfinished/untested.I don't think it's far off being good but cannot recommend in it's current state.

总结，有潜力，但是机制和平衡太差，还需要很多磨合，感觉就是美术做好了不管玩法就上架的半成品。如果你想当休闲游戏来玩，那这一点也不休闲，快跑 本来是个不错的主题，还以为会像paper please一样，你要保证自己不丢掉工作，同时会有一些特殊角色有特殊剧情，很可惜这不符合我的预期，每一天是一模一样的。（可能后面有特殊剧情我没玩到，但我已经没耐心继续玩了） 东西越堆越多，越来越难找，越来越难赚钱，电话根本来不及打，升级买不到（买了感觉不到增益），东西卖不出（因为塞不进盒子，还只能卖三个，还不一定卖得出），卡顿经常发生，我就是被卡退了才来写评论，整体体验极差 还有那个抢劫犯，给的反应时间太短，桌子上乱七八糟，找到道具喷他的时候他已经把我一天的工资偷完了，还会喷到其他的客人扣我工资。给家里的钱还每天增加，玩了5个游戏日，我的钱还停留在1000多块，这还是我没买任何升级的情况下，感觉一直在白干 接下来是比较个人的评价，如果是我太菜了，我的操作有问题，导致我的体验很差，那我认，但是我玩过比这更难玩的游戏，那些游戏给我的感觉是具有挑战性的，完成了很难的关卡是有丰厚的奖励或者有特殊的剧情，我会有强烈的成就感和满足感，这游戏就只是难，正面反馈是几乎为零，一点快乐的感觉都没有ヽ(`Д´)ﾉ

游戏寿命一个半小时吧，玩法就是给失主找到他自己的东西，但是有个问题，这游戏丢失的物品不绑定失主的，同一个东西会出现3个失主同时来要的情况。 还有就是银行那个意义不明的数值，那是通关要的钱吗？ 各种功能道具买回来结果还要占桌面位置 偷钱的人可以算抢钱，很少能防住，后面3000买个钱箱他直接就废了，这就是个意义不明的角色 电话非常没用，只有是你自己桌面上有的没找到时间不够了，你再重新打电话喊他回来，而且还必须是上班时间，下班后不能打电话，而且如果你桌上有东西，一定会有人来要的，所以电话就是摆设，第一时间没找到没给他，你就可以等下一个有缘人了 偷东西去卖也没做好，首先你得买一个放大镜知道价格，然后每天最多原价卖3个，如果直接卖就是白菜价，而且就算原价卖还是没有失主给的钱多 而且游戏难度没有成长，我玩的第三个难度，后面我桌上一张登机牌都是3个失主抢着要，来什么东西，马上就有人来要了，每天都是空空的，每天能赚多少钱就是看丢的东西贵不贵，不靠自己了，游戏那个幽默的通关金额，只能说有点好笑 最后说一下吧，这游戏玩法基本借鉴了沙威玛传奇，画风不错，游戏性目前还不怎么样，寿命很短，价格定的还算合理，但是玩过一次后就太无聊了，没有再玩的欲望了 想要做好你可以后期东西越给越多，你传送带旁边放个箱子，东西自动就掉在箱子里，不要没去拿就没了，难度要随着进度增加，给这个游戏里面的人物增加一些剧情，给他们指定的道具，就能触发剧情，给玩家一些反馈，玩家不是真的没事来找网上兼职的，是来玩游戏的，你做个上班一样的游戏没有人会玩的下去的

看游戏画风还以为是休闲游戏实际上高血压有了。 1.只有一个存档位，更换难度直接从头开始且存档丢失。 2.有的物品隔天会换样式…你家东西放隔夜会从蓝色变成黄色啊？ 3.全是拖拽操作的游戏，但是小偷纯属闪电侠，出场一秒都没有就要拿起辣椒水喷他，我只配眼睁睁看他偷。而且为什么辣椒水的判定也是拖拽啊，喷小偷路过客人把客人也喷走了我服了。 4.小游戏打完了的结算动画客人耐心条怎么还在计时啊…… 玩的日常难度：连续处理订单没有连击奖励，导致放置一两位客人没问题，不打电话也没问题。钱少又难处理的东西(如机票)就丢掉或偷走。客人来太快总要漏，小偷全靠现金收纳机防，特殊客人没什么明显作用，我感觉我在打高难本但开挂给自己加了个90%减伤。
比较无聊，道具设计得很一般。

unfurnished, unfinished and unpollished. the good: - you can rollplay as a deadbeat father slithering out of paying child suport. - cute artstyle. the bad (unpollished): - the physics are absolute dog puke, buggy items going everywhere and onto the conveyor belt, forcing you to divert your attention to getting them of it or else you lose. so. much. money. - its glitchy stuff like this that make the game feel, yk, bad to play. - dubbles of item requests? 2 or 3 ppl showing up at the same time or just after an item has been picked up, usually after calling a customer. - a new customer who wants the item shows up just before the person you called to pick up the item. the bad (the unfinished): - what does temprature do? i cant tell. thats how little this mechanic matters in most game modes - what does rank do? - what does the homelessguy do aside from cluttering up my table? - what does the adhd and autism mode do? I and my AuDHD can not tell. the bad (the unfurnished+ other stuff): - the game lacks 33% of the maps locations you can actually use, these shouldve been included in the release. the homeless guy even refrences the unavalable buildings, these arent upcoming free content updates, they are missing core gameplay mechanics wich absense makes the game feel like its in betatesting. - why does the customer speach bar cover part of the table? i either fail to give the item stuck under it or send them away by mistake. - items take up space on your table (duh) but both upgrades and money do too. if you dont actively pick up your money it starts displacing the other things on the table, the lose money also has physics and lagg the game out. could this not be changed by auto storing the money in the till? no physics strain and it would actually make sense for the theif to no longer be able to steal it. the ending: -the ending doesnt make sense. why would going on a vacation be a permanent escape from capitalist grind? and why can i chose if i bring my family or not but its still the same price?? there are all rhese choices around your family but no game response too them aside from game over. also your trip could only last about 200 days if the familes needs stayed the same. im sorry i just dont get it. everything you do in this game feels pointless, the gameplay loop has no real risk/reward. playing on the mayhem dificulty does not combat this. they cant even fire you for not doing your job. whats the point of working hard and not just stealing the expenisve stuff and giving out the ocational correct item, you can easily make more then the daily family needs. no spellchecking, no proof reading. i needed to get this of my chest because i really wanted to like this game but in its current state its both stressfull and boring, i dont know how you pulled this of but ,man, this sucks.

《失物招领模拟器》是一款类似于《沙威玛传奇》的休闲游戏，只不过玩家这次扮演的不再是土耳其餐厅里的大厨，而是一名在机场失物招领室的工作人员，玩家需要整理这些粗心的失主在机场的遗失物，并且在失主耐心耗尽前帮助他们找到遗失物。 本作的玩法比较简单，玩家需要在众多的遗失物传送带上找到失主的遗失物，并赚取人工费。这些遗失物小到常见的口红手机平板，大到甚至坦克都有（那么大的坦克怎么丢的EMMMM）。这款游戏主要考验的就是玩家的手速和眼力，其实还是蛮辛苦的。 游戏目前共有4个难度可供玩家选择，除了难度不同外，每种难度下玩家所要做的就是将遗失物在失主耐心值耗尽前交换给他，当然最低难度下这个耐心值是不存在的。 也许是制作组为了迷惑玩家，增加游戏的难度，部分遗失物外观设计的很相似，不仔细分辨很容易在手忙脚乱中搞错。而且这些东西有些在我看来就是同一种东西的不同叫法，例如童话书和儿童读物。 作为失物招领室的工作人员，我们赚取资金只能通过交还遗失物给失主这条正经途径，为了提升游戏趣味性，游戏中加入了黑市系统，玩家可以把一些高价值物品放进左下角箱子中（太大的放不进去例如：坦克）。且放进箱子里的物品无法再次取出，但是可以通过传送带刷新出来。 黑市中的交易大抵分成两种，一种是直接售卖，另一种就是自行定价放在黑市桌子上等客人购买。不过本来就是不义之财，肯定会低于物品的价值才能卖出，所以还是老老实实把东西交给失主才是正确的选择。 总的来说这款游戏画风比较简单，玩法也比较简单，游戏的整体UI设计简洁明了，属于快餐型的小游戏。如果能在移动端平板上，用手指拖动物品，我觉得会比鼠标操作更加方便游玩。 [quote]欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45214439/]轻游社[/url]，以轻松认真的态度，对待每一款游戏 [/quote]

It's a fun little game, but I think the game is somewhat misleading with the game status already on full release with "free content updates". This is an early access game, period. A good one at that. But still an early access, yet it's sold as a full release product. That's the reasoning why I can't recommend the game at this point. It's fun, it's cute, it has personality, albeit a very short experience. The game fell flat after around 2 hours mark as there's literally no progress anymore to be done, only repeating the same mundane activities with no goals. There are still some locked contents that are yet to be released. Which is, again, basically an early-access game sold as full product.

Got the paper thing from the store 3 days in so I never had to send money home again. Why AM I sending money home anyways? Felt very "Papers Please" but without a good explanation, after all "Papers Please" has multiple endings, but if you get three strikes here you just lose I think? What does the bank do? What am I saving for? Why can I just steal items and sell them at the black market without any repercussion? Like yeah I am stealing all of the laptops that are left over at the end of the day WHY wouldn't I? Why can I only buy one item at the store per day it's so nonsensical. Why do upgrades need to be stored on the table?? I got a fan and it just somewhere on the table and that makes the customers more patient how? I got the tipping box and yet I still have to manually click the tips? Why? An upgrade like that should eliminate the part where I need to collect it myself. Kept spraying the officer with the pepper spray he didn't like it but he kept coming back. But he kept asking for a wallet like four times a day and I thought that's annoying so I just started spraying him so that he left. If I didn't have an item I would just let the people leave without taking their number. Because sorting the numbers and keeping track is really annoying and then you need to call them with your phone and I promise you the second you wipe out the phone a robber will come and steal your money. It's just not worth it especially with the table space. Also, not a great look to have the robber look like a punk instead of... a robber? Anyways, I thought this looks cute and fun but I got like 15 days in, there was no storyline, the upgrades didn't improve the gameplay and clogged up my table and I have now refunded this on the basis of being very bored.

Another game from this developer where I’m surprised by the number of positive reviews. It’s an incredibly repetitive, grindy, and buggy game where you return people’s lost items. What you see in the first five minutes of gameplay is all you’re going to get. There are some upgrades, but almost every single one feels inconsequential and doesn’t really improve anything. They seem to exist just for the sake of being there. The gameplay loop is utterly boring and I say this as someone who normally enjoys games like this. If you care about achievements, there are two (“THE CHOSEN ONE” and “All Sticker Packs”) that are extremely grindy, well past the point where you would normally “beat” the game. Looking at the developer’s page, they seem to be churning out as many of these games as possible, which certainly explains a few things. I can say for sure I won’t be purchasing any more after playing the three I already own. As with the others, the only two good things I can mention are that the art style is nice and the Linux version works without any issues. You can find my reviews for Ship, Inc. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/MouseWithBeer/recommended/3496000]here[/url] and Carefully Stamped [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/MouseWithBeer/recommended/3771390]here[/url], which are from the same developer and share many of the same problems and go more into detail.

相当不好玩，不严谨也不休闲，更不有趣，不推荐购买。 先买了同公司的分拣员，玩起来体验不错，闲时打开玩一会很放松，虽然感觉更适配触屏，但可以接受。非常期待失物招领这个题材，打折时立刻买入，但非常失望。 相比起分拣员，压力很大，并且改模式需要“保存并退出”后再点击“新游戏”，所以错过了一开始重开的时机，就只能硬着头皮继续了。 开局时时间压力已经很紧张了，后续更紧张……升级了桌子对降低压力毫无帮助，因为是左右移动的，并且在玩到第20天后才发现桌子可以用A和D键移动，此前只能使用鼠标，于是有些当前桌子摆不下的东西就很难拿下传送带，会带来扣钱。东西被挤上传送带，扣钱。导致每天下班后要花更多时间整理桌子。 顾客都没什么耐心，走得飞快，但你不把东西给他们、把他们的电话扔进垃圾桶，也没什么损失。体感是损失还没传送带没取货大。顾客也超级不严谨，不需要核对他们丢失的物品什么颜色、有什么特征，反正名字对了就行了，很难评。分拣员还可以键盘输入单号，这个游戏打电话只能用鼠标点数字，费手+1（后来是有二维码扫描枪了，但第一时间买这个未免太奢侈？）。上班太忙了，想下班后给他打电话，不行；上班时错过别的顾客、顶着传送带扣款给他“点”完电话，我也没见着他来。不知道是bug还是故意这么设计的，总之后来电话便利贴一律扔垃圾桶，再后来甚至懒得回复“没有”。 小偷神烦，不喷辣椒水疯狂偷钱，辣椒水带到别的客人也扣钱，所以得第一时间买收银机。保安、黑市貌似都只有开局攒点数开商店有用，配上并不幽默的流浪汉和机器人一样的顾客，越玩越烦躁。 综上，在普通难度下，这是一个考验反应速度、鼠标耐久度、玩家的吃苦能力的游戏，最终玩法就是把所有东西都摆在桌子上，来那种图案大、小费多的顾客才递一下，然后从传送带立刻领到同款，放好，其余顾客全部无视。什么几个像素点大的口红，捡起来、递出去、捡起来、再摆好，是嫌自己没有腱鞘炎么…… 低难度模式可能好点吧，不造，反正我光速卸载了再也不想打开体验。

[h3] 不推荐！玩混乱模式的时候遇到一个令人想直接卸载的恶性Bug！ [/h3] 本来混乱模式到中期就是一个焦头烂额的状态，那个“给我一个有趣的东西”的小哥来了之后，可能是给了他一个“不有趣”的物品，他不仅把我桌子上所有物品搞乱（我知道这个是游戏正常流程），同时还导致了桌子上[b] 所有物品 [/b]都以匀速[b] 向左方传送带移动！！ [/b] 我虽然已经在很努力的抢救，把物品一个一个往右扔，但当时因为我的桌子上满满都是物品，我抢救回来的物品又被后面移动的物品推着往传送带去...谁能懂我当时的绝望！然后传送带还转得飞快，来不及抢救的（以及抢救了又被后面物品推着再次上了断头台的）物品就这样被一波一波无情的带走，[spoiler] 每个物品它是算价格的啊啊啊啊啊啊啊 [/spoiler]导致直接亏本上班，本来在这个混乱模式前期整点资金不容易，硬生生给我一夜回到解放前...然后就更别提同时再把物品交给丢东西的顾客了，根本啥都顾不上了... 除此恶性Bug外，还有各种小Bug。比如呼叫顾客回来拿他丢的东西，结果他回来又需要另一种不存在的东西。（因为那个“没有”的按键不存在，所以可以确定这个顾客就是被我重新叫回来的顾客） 总之，在遇到这个恶性Bug前，我认为此游戏需要多更新些内容才能配得上“值得一玩”。但在打折的时候买的话，目前版本也算是“能玩”。但是！[b] 遇到这个恶性Bug之后真的非常不推荐，只要碰到就直接毁了整个游戏心情的程度 [/b]

i'd give this game a 6/10 overall. Fun for a while and then it becomes so ridiculously overwhelming I can't even describe it. The table upgrades are almost useless because you have to hold and scroll to the other side of the table so what's the point in having a bigger table if you can't see everything on it. Plus the items can quite literally take up the entire table and the conveyor belt never stops giving you items. And customers won't come pick up the huge items for days and it just sits and takes up space. And then if I finally decide to throw the item away the conveyor belt almost immediately gives me the same item right back. AND the penalty for not getting stuff off the conveyor belt gets bigger and bigger. Sometimes there's a glitch where if you don't perfectly give the item you can no longer see it and it's off screen and people will continue to come and ask for it over and over again, yet it's disappeared from the screen and unattainable again. Overall if you like mayhem go ahead, but if you want something relaxing, I don't recommend. I prefer Ship, Inc. to this game.

This game slowly turned me into an airport employee... and then held me hostage with stickers. Lost But Found starts off really strong, but unfortunately loses momentum the longer you play. You work at an airport, returning lost items to their owners, playing little mini-games, earning money, and buying upgrades. It's a cozy and satisfying gameplay loop that works really well. The problem is that you unlock everything fairly quickly. Once you've bought all the upgrades and earned enough money to finish the game, there's barely anything new left to discover. From that point on, you're mostly repeating the same tasks over and over. Now, I should mention that I went for 100% achievements, and that's where my frustration really came from. The sticker collection sounded fun at first... until I realized how incredibly random it is. Getting every sticker took far longer than earning every other achievement in the game. At some point I wasn't managing an airport anymore—I was managing my disappointment every time another duplicate sticker appeared xD Then there's the achievement for completing 100 successful days. By around halfway through, you've already unlocked basically everything, so the remaining days mostly feel like waiting for the counter to reach 100... while desperately hoping the sticker gods finally show mercy. That said, if you simply want a cozy job simulator, this is still a good game. I also have to admit that I played Ship, Inc. first, and I enjoyed that one so much that it probably made Lost But Found feel weaker than it actually is. So if you like relaxing simulator games, I still think this one is worth checking out. Just... prepare yourself for those stickers. xD

Good idea, poor execution. This is going to be my first game refund. Firstly, the time mechanics are bizarre. I found myself alternating between incredibly stressed (in a not-fun way) at the normal/hard difficulties, and incredibly bored at the casual/easy difficulties. I think they should have implemented some kind of customer conveyer belt mechanism for easy mode, so you're not just waiting ages in-between everyone. Secondly, because this almost entirely a time-based hidden object game (and no other genre - don't let the marketing fool you), they try to shoe-horn in other mechanics to make it more fun, like mini games, robbers, etc. These are terrible, and only serve to detract from, not add to, the game. Finally, and importantly, this game has an INCREDIBLY annoying and long-standing bug. One of the features (which I feel is the most interesting one!!) is that if you don't have an object someone is looking for, you can ask them to leave their number and you can call them back. Unfortunately, this barely works. Half the time they don't show up, and when they do, half the time they're looking for an ENTIRELY DIFFERENT OBJECT. Except this time, you can't even ask them to come back!!
